HS_bracket_algebra.H_S_reduced_form: 2 N_H^2 + 2|k| rS N_H - 2|k| N_H |S| + (|S|^2 - rS^2)^2  (after Cauchy-Schwarz |H.H| <= N_H)
HS_bracket_algebra.argument: t = |S| - rS.  t <= 0: every term of 2 N_H^2 + 2|k| N_H (-t) + t^2 (|S| + rS)^2 is >= 0 and the sum is 0 iff N_H = 0 and t = 0 (|S| + rS >= rS > 0).  t > 0: the sum equals 2 (N_H - |k| t/2)^2 + t^2 [(|S| + rS)^2 - k^2/2] with (|S| + rS)^2 > 4 rS^2 > k^2/2, so it is > 0.  Hence V_HS + rS^4 = 0 iff H = 0 and |S| = rS (Cauchy-Schwarz makes V_HS >= the reduced form).

The domain is sharp: V >= V0 fails for every kappa^2 > 8 rS^2 (exact violating points), while at kappa^2 = 8 rS^2 the bound and the equality set still hold (lambda_eff = 0); the certified domain is the open kappa^2 < 8 rS^2.  Exact over Q at (r0, rS, x0, kappa) = (1/5,1/5,1,-1/20), (1/5,1,1,-1/100), (1/5,1,1,-1/4) and the stress point (1/5,5,1,-5/4) (outside the |c| < 12 perturbative box, eps window 12 - 2|kappa| rS empty; an exact family member only): grad V(q0) = 0, the 486 x 486 Hessian has inertia 447/39/0 at eps = 0 (kernel = 35 orbit tangents + 4 real doublet directions) and 451/35/0 at eps = r0^2/100 and r0^2/10^6 (kernel = the orbit tangents), identical to the committed witness at rS = r0.  The orbit ranks are 33/34/35 at rS in {1/10, 1/5, 1, 2}; F_PQ^2 = 9248 rS^2 x0^2/(16 rS^2 + 289 x0^2) with S share 289 x0^2/(16 rS^2 + 289 x0^2), Phi17 share 16 rS^2/(16 rS^2 + 289 x0^2) and no Sigma share.
